card-fool.name: 0 — The Fool
card-fool.Scene: A ragged jester in a parti-coloured garment waves a staff. A small animal (cat or dog) clings to or nips at his lower garments. His posture is erratic, head thrown back. The figure is painted on gilt vellum with extraordinary fineness.

card-emperor.name: 4 — The Emperor
card-emperor.Scene: An armoured emperor sits in near-profile on a stone seat, wearing a jewelled crown and an ermine-trimmed crimson mantle. He holds a sceptre or orb; a sword may rest at his side. The background is plain gilded vellum.

card-pope.name: 5 — The Pope
card-pope.Scene: A pope in white pontifical vestments and triple tiara is enthroned and raises his right hand in blessing. Two tonsured kneeling clerics are visible at lower left and right. The background is richly gilded.

card-lovers.name: 6 — The Lovers
card-lovers.Scene: Two elegantly dressed young figures — a man and a woman — stand facing each other beneath a winged Cupid or angel who aims an arrow between them. The costumes reflect North Italian courtly fashion of the 1470s.

card-chariot.name: 7 — The Chariot
card-chariot.Scene: A crowned triumphator stands erect in a canopied chariot, holding a sceptre or sword. Two horses (often of contrasting colours) draw the chariot. The scene evokes a Roman triumph.

card-justice.name: 8 — Justice
card-justice.Scene: A crowned female figure sits on a throne, holding a drawn sword upright in her right hand and a set of scales in her left. She is frontally posed in the standard allegorical Justice composition.

card-hermit.name: 9 — The Hermit (Time)
card-hermit.Scene: An elderly robed man walks hunched over his staff, holding an hourglass before him. In some versions a lantern replaces the hourglass. He is shown in isolation, moving across a plain ground. The Charles VI Hermit famously holds an hourglass rather than a lantern.

card-strength.name: 11 — Strength
card-strength.Scene: A crowned woman in a long gown gently opens the jaws of a lion with her bare hands. The lion does not resist; the woman's posture is calm and assured.

card-hanged-man.name: 12 — The Hanged Man
card-hanged-man.Scene: A male figure hangs by one foot from a gallows or cross-bar, his free leg crossed behind the suspended one. His arms hang loosely or are clasped behind his back. The face is tranquil.

card-death.name: 13 — Death
card-death.Scene: A skeleton brandishes a scythe or sword above fallen and kneeling figures of various social ranks — a crowned king, a bishop, a commoner. The skeleton's movement is relentless across a barren field.

card-temperance.name: 14 — Temperance
card-temperance.Scene: A winged angel pours liquid between two vessels — one elevated, one lower — without spilling. The figure is standing or gently kneeling, wearing a long gown in blue and white.

card-tower.name: 16 — The Tower (House of the Devil)
card-tower.Scene: A stone tower on rocky ground is struck by fire from above; its crenellated crown is shattered and two figures fall from the windows. Flames issue from the battlements.

card-moon.name: 18 — The Moon
card-moon.Scene: A crescent moon face hangs above a darkened landscape with two towers in the background. A crayfish or lobster emerges from water in the foreground; two dogs stand below.

card-sun.name: 19 — The Sun
card-sun.Scene: A radiant sun with a face shines above. Below, two children or a male and female figure stand or play in a garden beneath the solar disc.

card-judgement.name: 20 — Judgement
card-judgement.Scene: A trumpet-blowing angel emerges from a cloud above while three figures — man, woman, child — rise from tombs with arms raised toward the angel. The composition is the standard Judgement iconography.

card-world.name: 21 — The World
card-world.Scene: A nude or lightly draped androgynous figure dances at the centre of a laurel wreath. In the four corners appear the four tetramorph creatures: angel, eagle, lion, and bull.

card-page-swords.name: Page of Swords
card-page-swords.Scene: A youthful page stands in a landscape, wearing a fitted tunic and holding a drawn sword. The pose suggests alertness and readiness. The figure is painted on vellum with fine detail in the costume.

emg-surviving-trumps.name: The 16 Surviving Trumps
emg-surviving-trumps.Scene: Sixteen cards from what was once a complete Italian tarot set, painted on vellum with gold leaf by an unknown Milanese or Lombard master c. 1470–1480. The cards survived as a group in the Bibliothèque nationale de France, misattributed for centuries to Charles VI (r. 1380–1422) and to the painter Jacquemin Gringonneur.
